card: Extracts the NodeId type declaration into a dedicated node/node_id.h header and cleans up direct include statements across 10 files that previously relied on transitive imports. This resolves symbol source ambiguity for static analysis tooling like IWYU caused by duplicate declarations. The author identifies this refactor as a prerequisite for PR 36808.
evidence: PR description: "Two identical declarations of `NodeId` make it ambiguous for static tools such as IWYU which header should provide the symbol."
problem: `NodeId` has two identical declarations, creating ambiguity for static analysis tools such as include-what-you-use (IWYU) over which header canonicalizes the symbol. Several files also rely on transitive includes via `net.h` and `node/eviction.h`.

risk.why: A mistake in header dependencies would cause build-time compilation errors.

scope_notes: Small mechanical header reorganization across 10 files.
summary: Extracts the `NodeId` declaration into a standalone `node/node_id.h` header, re-exporting it from `net.h`. Cleans up `#include` directives in `net` and `node/eviction` modules, adding direct includes for headers previously imported transitively.
uncertainties: Diff was not provided in the input, though commit messages and PR description detail the exact mechanical changes.
